## My Cycle 1.1.3

### RuStore publication
- Fixed the permanent Android Application ID / Bundle ID and namespace at `com.sl.mycycle`.
- Refactored source, test and debug package paths plus the Room schema package to match the canonical identity.
- Added a signed Android App Bundle (`.aab`) release pipeline with SHA-256 verification and the public upload certificate required for store onboarding.
- Added automated 1080×1920 RuStore screenshots generated from the real app UI with debug-only local demo data.
- Added English and Russian privacy policies and a maintained RuStore store-listing file.

### Compatibility note
Pre-1.1.3 GitHub builds have a different Android application identity and Android treats them as a separate app. `com.sl.mycycle` is the permanent Application ID / Bundle ID and namespace from this release onward.

The app remains offline-first: no account, analytics, ads or Android `INTERNET` permission.
